description: Search EPA compliance, TRI, Superfund, drinking-water, EJScreen, and AirNow data.
name: io.github.cyanheads/epa-mcp-server

environmentVariables.description: Optional AirNow API key for real-time and forecast air quality data. When unset, the epa_get_air_quality tool is not registered and the other tools run without it. Free registration at docs.airnowapi.org.
environmentVariables.name: AIRNOW_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the EJScreen (EJAM) API base URL used by epa_get_ejscreen. Defaults to https://api.ejanalysis.com — the community-maintained EJScreen rehost by Public Environmental Data Partners.
environmentVariables.name: EJSCREEN_API_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
